result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both charts start at zero, sort the sites by count, label every value directly and use a title that states a finding, so they are very close. A adds Quarry Loop as the low point in its subtitle and a note saying the sites are sorted by count. B shows a rendering glitch: a few stray gridline pieces float between the North Ridge and Alder Run bars. A's faint full-height gridlines add a little clutter, but they are consistent and do not get in the way of reading the values. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both are sorted horizontal bar charts that start at zero, with direct value labels and a title that states the takeaway. B's subtitle adds that Quarry Loop had the fewest and its footnote explains the sort order, though its full-height gridlines add a little clutter and the subtitle leaves an orphaned '29.' on its own line. A is cleaner overall, but stray gridline fragments show between the North Ridge and Alder Run bars, which looks like a rendering bug.
